body.content: Counterfactual: If the event log used a single-writer, single-threaded, no-retry model, idempotence would be unnecessary. But this breaks the at-least-once delivery assumption — the problem explicitly states retries happen. So the necessity of idempotence is conditional on the delivery model, not on the log itself.
body.unfinished: Could refine to show exactly how at-least-once delivery forces the idempotence requirement.
body.why_keep_this: Clarifies that the required property is jointly determined by delivery semantics and operation semantics, not by the log alone.
